{'index': 0, 'translation': 'At WWDC 2021, Apple announced support for storing driver\'s licenses in Apple Wallet on iPhone. At the time, Apple marketed the feature as the final step to letting you "completely ditch your physical wallet."'}

{'index': 1, 'translation': "Here are the states where Apple Wallet driver's license support is coming..."}

{'index': 2, 'translation': 'Apple Wallet ID support'}

{'index': 3, 'translation': "In the five years since Apple announced the feature, support has gradually expanded across the United States. Currently, iPhone and Apple Watch users in 14 states and Puerto Rico can add a driver's license or state ID to Apple Wallet. Tap here for the complete list:"}

{'index': 4, 'translation': "Where is the feature rolling out next? Here's what we know so far."}

{'index': 5, 'translation': "The following seven states have confirmed they are working on Apple Wallet driver's license support, have been listed by Apple as partners, or have appeared in Apple code:"}

  • {'index': 6, 'translation': 'Kentucky (launching "summer" 2026)'}
  • {'index': 7, 'translation': 'North Carolina (launching early 2027)'}
  • {'index': 8, 'translation': 'Oklahoma (in development, launch date TBD)'}
  • {'index': 9, 'translation': 'Utah (in development, launch date TBD)'}
  • {'index': 10, 'translation': 'Virginia (in development, launch date TBD)'}
  • {'index': 11, 'translation': 'Connecticut (status unclear, previously listed by Apple as a partner)'}
  • {'index': 12, 'translation': 'Mississippi (status unclear, previously listed by Apple as a partner)'}

{'index': 13, 'translation': "Meanwhile, the Secure Technology Alliance has been tracking the rollout of mobile driver's licenses across the United States. The following states have begun exploring mobile ID support through legislation or studies, but have not been mentioned by Apple:"}

  • {'index': 14, 'translation': 'Indiana'}
  • {'index': 15, 'translation': 'Vermont'}
  • {'index': 16, 'translation': 'New Jersey'}
  • {'index': 17, 'translation': 'Florida'}
  • {'index': 18, 'translation': 'South Carolina'}
  • {'index': 19, 'translation': 'Tennessee'}
  • {'index': 20, 'translation': 'Missouri'}
  • {'index': 21, 'translation': 'Nevada'}
  • {'index': 22, 'translation': 'Wyoming'}

{'index': 23, 'translation': "It's important to note that progress can vary greatly from state to state. A state exploring or developing digital ID support doesn't necessarily mean it will eventually launch, let alone be added to Apple Wallet."}

{'index': 24, 'translation': 'Wrap-up'}

{'index': 25, 'translation': "As you can see, the expansion of Apple Wallet driver's license support across the United States remains quite scattered."}

{'index': 26, 'translation': "However, you don't have to wait until your state supports Apple Wallet's digital ID feature to try it out."}

{'index': 27, 'translation': "Last year, Apple launched a new Digital ID feature powered by a U.S. passport. While it's not your driver's license, you can use it at TSA checkpoints at more than 250 airports across the country with your iPhone."}

{'index': 28, 'translation': "Have you stored your ID or driver's license in Apple Wallet on your iPhone? Have you actually used it? Let us know in the comments."}
